data.body: Parent-sync live fixes landed on autofix-chunk12-20260603 in commit 771dd2e2ef: (a) get_parent_map migrated to POST /rest/api/3/search/jql with nextPageToken cursor pagination (legacy /search retired, HTTP 410; startAt now rejected with 400); (b) HTTP 410 logged at ERROR (loud) in get_parent_map + fetcher enrichment catch, transients stay WARNING; (c) create path now attaches parent — no-JSON path passes --parent <key>, --from-json path falls back to set_parent(new_key, parent_key); AcliClient.create_issue extracts parent from the create payload (bare key string today, nested {key:K} accepted defensively); (d) hierarchy guard — only Epic can be a parent on this next-gen project, Task->Task rejected HTTP 400; parent ops (applier set_parent + create-time fallback) treat 400 as hierarchy rejection (WARN 'parent sync skipped' + continue pass), and outbound_differ suppresses the parent diff when the resolved local parent ticket_type != epic to prevent perpetual re-emission (sync exclusion mirroring 36af). Comment-enrichment perf follow-on in commit 1b621b3877. Reconciler suite 788 passed / 1 pre-existing failure (test_e2e_dedup_pass) / 2 xfail. Ticket left OPEN pending live re-probe validation.
